description: THE HOSTS' OWN EDIT of a wedding or other personal event. IT APPLIES THE CHANGE ON THIS CALL, one `field` per call, and the reply says the detail now and before: read both out. A time needs am or pm, or a 24 hour time that reads one way; a bare "4:30" is refused. For faq_answer, `question` adds the entry or replaces its answer. Every change is logged and can be read back; event_change_undo reverses the caller's own latest one. Only the hosts can change it; read refusals (NOT_A_HOST, BAD_TIME, NO_SUCH_PLACE, NO_SUCH_ENTRY, NO_CHANGE) out as given; it sends no message and it changes nothing else on the event; the event's Wallet passes are updated with the new detail as a lock-screen notice and the reply's `passNotice` says how many passes were reached. Needs a personal connector token.

entryTitle.description: For schedule_time: the row title as spelled.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or the event name as the hosts spell it.

field.description: Which detail. The place fields take an optional `venueName`; schedule_time takes `entryTitle`; faq_answer takes `question`.

value.description: The new value, as the hosts say it: a time, a place, a sentence or an answer. No links or markup.

venueName.description: Optional venue name, for the place fields.

name: event_change_detail
title: Change one detail of a personal event (hosts only)
